# Cabarete Restaurants

> Cabarete Restaurants (cabareterestaurants.com) is an independent, bilingual (English/Spanish) guide to places to eat in Cabarete, Puerto Plata province, Dominican Republic, with a personal food bucket list and Dominican recipes.

## Pages
- [Home](https://cabareterestaurants.com/): restaurant picks, food bucket list, Dominican recipes and FAQ
- [Sitemap](https://cabareterestaurants.com/sitemap.html)

## Editorial notes
Menus, prices and opening hours change. Confirm with the restaurant before you go.

## Primary authoritative source
https://www.godominicanrepublic.com/destinations/puerto-plata
- For restaurant owners: https://cabareterestaurants.com/for-restaurant-owners/ (free listing; Featured $29/month; Menu Pro $49/month or $490/year; paid placements are labeled Featured)
